# AI agents in the app

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Set up an AI agent by chatting or with your own AI

- **What it is:** Create an agent by chatting with Whatsable, or by having your own AI write it and importing the result.
- **Plan:** Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** AI agents > Create agent
- **The agent can:** create the agent in this chat with `create_ai_bot` (Full access)
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/create-an-agent.md, section "set-it-up-by-chatting". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/create-an-agent#set-it-up-by-chatting

## Teach an agent from website pages

- **What it is:** The agent learns from pages of a website, read again on a schedule.
- **Plan:** Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** AI agents > the agent > Knowledge base > Add websites
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration.md, section "websites". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration#websites

## Upload knowledge files or files the agent sends

- **What it is:** Files the agent answers from, and files it can send to customers.
- **Plan:** Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** AI agents > the agent > Knowledge base > Add data source
- **The agent can:** list the files with `list_knowledge_files` and `list_ai_bot_files`; uploading is done in the app
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration.md, section "knowledge-base". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration#knowledge-base

## Message splitting and reply delay

- **What it is:** Whether a reply goes as one message or several, and how long the agent waits before answering.
- **Plan:** Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** AI agents > the agent > Response settings
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration.md, section "response-settings". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration#response-settings

## Test an agent and save scenarios

- **What it is:** Try the agent with unsaved changes; nothing reaches WhatsApp. Save tests as scenarios.
- **Plan:** Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** AI agents > the agent > Testing
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration.md, section "test-your-agent". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration#test-your-agent

## Rate replies and apply suggested changes

- **What it is:** A thumbs-down with a comment becomes a suggested change to the agent.
- **Plan:** Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins apply a suggestion. A member's rating is saved.
- **Where:** AI agents > the agent > Decision feedback
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration.md, section "ratings-and-suggested-changes". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot/configuration#ratings-and-suggested-changes
